app.title: Show HN: Sigabrt.dev – cronjob monitor with an SSH TUI
app.description: A terminal user interface that monitors cron jobs over SSH, displaying status and logs in a navigable dashboard.
proposed_tests: Install via cargo or prebuilt binary and run `sigabrt --help`
Connect to a local SSH host and monitor a test cronjob, verify status updates
Measure startup time and memory usage
Check log output capture and filtering functionality
